why: A line due 15 July is owed NOW, not in July: a column for a month that has gone is a column
nobody can act in. So a past-due line is read at today - it takes the on hand it can still
be served from, and whatever is left of it lands in the CURRENT month's balance.
Lead 30 here rather than 90, so the red horizon (10 Oct) is inside the axis and September's
debt is red because no purchase could reach it.
